scenes.title: 完整宫殿群 · 西北鸟瞰
zh: 西北鸟瞰将完整高台作为一座连续的王宫群呈现：入口位于近处，阿帕达纳与百柱厅分列开阔庭院两侧，南部住宅和库房向山脚延伸。人物只是很小的尺度标记，宏伟来自柱厅跨度、台基与广场的组合。
主要建筑关系来自实际读过的总平面；模型坐标为人工近似注册。完整屋顶、外墙高度、彩绘、山体和人群是推定，不能据此测算古代人口或宫殿容纳量。入口曾修正不合原址的独立兽像与直阶梯，原始版本保留。
en: The northwest aerial presents the terrace as a continuous palace compound, linking the entrance, two great halls, southern palaces and treasury. Small human figures make the architectural scale legible.
Principal relationships follow inspected plans. Roofs, wall heights, colours, terrain and activity remain hypotheses; the image is not a population estimate or a precision survey.

scenes.title: 完整宫殿群 · 西南鸟瞰
zh: 西南方向的第二张总览把南部王宫移到近景，公共柱厅与北部开敞区退向远处。同一高台的另一条对角线揭示了宫殿并非只有正面：平台高差、内院、屋顶与连接空间共同组成其厚度。
此图必须与西北鸟瞰保持同一建筑群的大体位置与尺度。生成图之间的屋檐、门洞、彩绘和人物并非逐像素锁定；统一模型只保证制作使用了同一套体量参照，不能替代专业测绘复核。
en: The southwest aerial reverses the diagonal: royal residences come forward while public halls recede. Platforms, courts and roofs show the compound’s depth rather than only its facade.
Both aerials use the same reference mesh. Fine roof, doorway and decorative details are generative interpretations, not a promise of pixel-identical reconstruction.

scenes.title: 登上帝国高台
zh: 从平原接近高台，视线先遇到巨大的石砌挡墙，再沿浅踏步登向入口。人物与墙体的比例说明，进入王宫是一段有距离、有高差的过程，而非跨过一间小屋的门槛。
双折返阶梯有遗存依据，模型则简化了踏步和转折细部。每侧111级属于结构约束，不能用AI画面逐级计数作验证。地面访客、守卫和服饰是在时代条件下安排的情境。
en: At ground level the terrace wall precedes the gate. Shallow stair flights turn the approach into a long ceremonial ascent, with people small beside the masonry.
The double-reversed arrangement is evidence-based, but individual treads and landings are simplified. The generated image does not certify every step or a documented visiting event.

scenes.title: 万国门的巨型门廊
scenes.en_title: The monumental Gate of All Lands
zh: 万国门的近景强调厚重门框与高大有顶空间。石构守护兽应属于门洞自身的雕刻构件，门内柱列支承木梁，人站在下方才显出其体量。
四柱厅、矩形门洞和保存柱件提供约束；完整泥砖墙、梁架和配色仍需推定。不能把图中的装饰纹样作为铭文摹本，也不以画面确认全部构件的精确尺寸。
en: The gate view stresses massive rectangular portals and the height of the roofed hall. Guardian animals belong to carved doorway elements rather than an invented line of independent statues.
The four-column plan constrains the scene; complete walls, roof framing and colour remain reconstructed. Decorative marks are not authenticated inscription transcriptions.

scenes.title: 阿帕达纳与朝见庭院
zh: 阿帕达纳前庭保留大面积开敞空间，台阶与北门廊把视线引向巨柱和完整屋顶。它的气势来自柱列与人物间的高差，以及广场为建筑留下的距离。
模型固定北门廊两排、每排六柱，并让阿帕达纳高于百柱厅。图像保留柱厅类型和尺度感，具体可见柱数、屋顶构造、塔角高度和全部雕刻组合不作精确考古认证。
en: The Apadana court remains spacious. A raised podium and north portico lead the eye toward great columns and a complete roof, with people giving scale.
The mesh fixes a two-by-six north portico and the taller Apadana mass. Visible counts, complete roof construction and reconstructed decorative combinations are not independently certified.

scenes.title: 阿帕达纳 · 柱林内部
zh: 阿帕达纳内部把外部的宏伟转为可感的空间深度：高柱、木梁与远处门洞重复出现，人在其中只是很小的一部分。屋顶封闭，日光由建筑开口进入，呈现完整使用中的大厅。
6×6柱网与主厅尺度由资料约束。全部木顶、涂色、室内明暗和人物活动则属于推定；没有人为增加天窗、现代照明或虚构巨型王座。
en: Inside the Apadana, high columns, long timber spans and distant portals turn exterior grandeur into depth. Daylight enters from architectural openings beneath a complete roof.
The six-by-six grid is fixed in the reference model. Ceiling details, colour, lighting and human activity remain interpretations rather than recovered interior photographs.

scenes.title: 百柱厅与北侧门廊
scenes.en_title: Hundred Column Hall and north portico
zh: 百柱厅北侧门廊展示另一种宏伟：较低的屋顶覆盖更密集、更宽广的柱列。庭院与门廊的连续关系使其成为整座宫殿群中的大型空间，而非孤立亭子。
主厅10×10柱网与北廊2×8柱网必须分开。这里的百柱厅也不等同库房内另一座百柱库厅。模型固定这些区别，生成图的细部可见计数仍有局限。
en: The north portico introduces the Hundred Column Hall as a broad, lower mass linked to its forecourt. Its grandeur differs from the taller Apadana.
The main ten-by-ten grid and north two-by-eight portico are separate. This public hall is not the other hundred-column storage hall in the treasury.

scenes.title: 百柱厅 · 深处的秩序
zh: 百柱厅内部以更密集的柱阵展开长距离视线。宽大的地面与有顶空间共同表现其秩序，少量远处人物让柱间距和屋顶高度更容易感知。
参考模型包含100根主厅柱，但一个透视画面无法同时看清全部柱子。完整梁架与墙面仍是复原方案，人物不被认定为某位国王或某次真实朝会。
en: Long diagonals through a dense column grid reveal the scale of the roofed Hundred Column Hall. A few distant figures clarify spacing and height.
The mesh contains one hundred main columns, but no single perspective reveals them all. Roof framing, surfaces and activity remain hypotheses.

scenes.title: 王宫台基与私庭
zh: 南部王宫从公共柱厅转向多层台基、较小门廊和内院。塔查拉、哈迪什与中央连接空间形成一组可相互辨认的体量，远处仍能看到大型柱厅的背景。
已知位置和柱网与失去的上部建筑分开处理。PalaceH的早期阶段存在争议，本作只采用假设体块，不复制后来王朝加建的雕刻阶梯。侍从执杯或携物只是使用情境，不能证明一次具体宴饮。
en: Southern royal palaces use separate podiums, smaller porticoes and courts, while the public halls remain in the background. Tachara, Hadish and the central connection are distinct masses.
Lost upper structures and disputed early Palace H phases remain explicit hypotheses. Attendants carrying vessels illustrate use rather than establish a particular feast.

scenes.title: 东侧山坡回望宫殿群
scenes.en_title: The terrace seen from the eastern hillside
zh: 东侧山坡回望把库房和百柱厅置于近处，较高的阿帕达纳、入口与南部宫殿延伸到远侧。第三个总览方向把王宫、山体与平原联系起来，进一步说明高台的完整范围。
山形没有使用实测DEM，平原上的田地与远景只作背景解释。后期山坡王陵被排除；图像不是整个古代城市的复原，不能由远景房屋推断巴尔萨的实际面积或人口。
en: The eastern hillside view places treasury and the Hundred Column Hall nearer the observer, with Apadana and the rest of the terrace beyond. It connects palace, hill and plain.
Terrain is schematic without a surveyed DEM. Later hillside tombs are excluded; distant fields or settlement hints do not constitute a reconstruction of the whole city.

scenes.title: 主要活动区域 · 区域全景
scenes.en_title: Regional panorama of the principal activity areas
zh: 区域全景将宫殿高台放回更广的聚落景观：台下大型建筑向南北延展，西侧居住与工匠活动区分布在园地之间，菲鲁齐早期建筑区位于更远的西侧。北侧王陵与河流、农田提供区域背景，高台内外承担着不同活动。
区域位置和开敞形态有研究依据，住宅数量、上部建筑、田园分块及具体人口均未被本作确认。菲鲁齐较早的建筑是否在430BCE全部使用也未知。这是主要区域的解释性全景，不能视为所有活动已知、每座房屋均已测绘的完整城市图。
en: The regional panorama places the royal terrace within a wider settlement landscape: large buildings extend below it, western living and craft clusters alternate with gardens, and older Firuzi monuments lie farther west. Northern cliffs and cultivated land provide the broader setting.

Sector locations and open landscape organisation have research support. Individual houses, density, complete upper structures and430BCE occupancy remain hypothetical. This is a panorama of principal regions, not an exhaustive contemporary city survey.

failures.observed_zh: 前序智慧宫练习中，缺乏尺度证据的狭小院落未能表达用户期待的机构和活动范围。
failures.action_zh: 波斯波利斯案例分别表达完整宫殿高台与外围主要活动区。
failures.lesson_zh: 平面或人口未知，既不能推出“小院子”，也不能授权创造巨大城市。
failures.origin: predecessor Baghdad exercise; retrospective lesson, not an initial Persepolis image
failures.evidence_scope: Current regional addendum documents the response; predecessor output/raw conversation are not bundled.

failures.observed: Freestanding beasts, retaining-wall figures and a straight stair appeared in the first generated aerial.
failures.action: Two targeted image edits using the revised stair structure reference.
failures.lesson: Review the actual result against named constraints; a supplied structure image is not a guarantee.
failures.observed_zh: 初次全景出现独立巨兽、挡墙人物带与直线阶梯。
failures.action_zh: 实际执行两次定向修改，并加入修订后的阶梯结构参考。
failures.lesson_zh: 提供结构图不等于成图服从模型，仍须检查实际结果；细部台阶与柱数仍有边界。

failures.observed: A photographic style master dominated the requested reverse viewpoint.
failures.action: Regenerate from the mesh view and source plan without the photographic style master.
failures.lesson: Reference roles can compete; use geometry/camera evidence independently from style.
failures.observed_zh: 风格参考图压过了所要求的反向视角。
failures.action_zh: 改用模型机位与考古平面重新生成，不再输入摄影风格主图。
failures.lesson_zh: 不同参考图会竞争，空间与机位输入应和风格角色分开。

failures.topic: PP04: unsupported head diagnosis and residual anatomy
failures.observed: The edit prompt diagnosed human heads, but independent inspection of the preserved before/after images found bovine attributes in both; the original diagnosis is not demonstrated.
failures.action: Retain the actual edit, input/output and original QA, and correct the public interpretation rather than presenting the instruction as proof.
failures.lesson: An edit request and a historical PASS do not establish the original defect or its repair. Inspect both images; residual body/pose/detail remains illustrative.
failures.topic_zh: PP04：守护兽误诊与未解决细部
failures.observed_zh: 原编辑指令将守护兽诊断为人头，但独立复核发现保留的前后两版都已有牛头特征，原诊断缺乏图像支持。
failures.action_zh: 保留实际编辑、两版图、提示词与旧审核，同时公开更正解释，不再把指令当成修复成功的证据。
failures.lesson_zh: 想修什么、调用过工具、旧记录写了 PASS，都不能证明原图确有该问题或已被修复；身体姿态和雕刻细部仍仅作示意。

failures.observed: The portico column sequence was excessive or ambiguous.
failures.action: A targeted edit changed the spacing/sequence.
failures.lesson: The mesh invariant can pass while visible AI column counts remain unverified.
failures.observed_zh: 生成图的柱序过多或不清楚。
failures.lesson_zh: 模型柱网检查与照片中的可见柱数是两项检查，后者仍未独立精确核验。

failures.observed: The terrace could be mistaken for the entire inhabited city.
failures.action: Add PP11 and regional evidence; label individual houses and synchronous occupation as hypotheses.
failures.lesson: A principal-sector panorama is not an exhaustive city survey or census.
failures.topic_zh: 城市与高台的范围混淆
failures.observed_zh: 仅展示高台，容易让读者把王室核心误认为全部城市。
failures.action_zh: 增加 PP11、区域研究与外围活动区模型，明确住宅和同期使用状态的推定。
failures.lesson_zh: 主要分区全景不是完整同期城市测绘，更不能反推人口。

failures.observed: A former painter-style viewer could hide roofs despite passing functional UI checks.
failures.action: Replace it with depth-tested rendering and inspect screenshots.
failures.lesson: Functional interaction tests and visible model correctness are separate checks.
failures.observed_zh: 旧版绘制顺序可能把屋顶遮住，即使按钮等交互已经通过检查。
failures.action_zh: 改用有深度测试的模型显示，并检查实际截图。
failures.lesson_zh: 功能测试和视觉正确性必须分别验证。原平台曾有浏览器沙箱启动失败，环境缺口与模型缺陷分开记录。

failures.observed: The large OIP68 download did not complete within the bounded attempts.
failures.action: Use the acquired OIC21 report and catalogue evidence; preserve the access gap.
failures.lesson: A catalogue or partial transfer is not a read full book. Retry only for a named gap and a justified bounded method.
failures.observed_zh: 大体积 OIP68 未在有界尝试内下载完成。
failures.action_zh: 使用实际取得的 OIC21、已读图版与目录信息，并保留访问缺口。
failures.lesson_zh: 目录或部分传输不能算全文已读；只有明确的新证据缺口与有界方法才支持重试。
